Name: Rasmodia Alternate Portraits for Compatiblity with Xtardew
Author: USER4397
Description: Alternate portraits for Rasmodia along with extra edits. Made for compatibility with Xtardew scenes, as well as giving hatless variants of her usual portraits etc. The mod folder provides no functionality on its own. You must take the character portraits within the folder and replace the portraits in the Romanceable Rasmodia and in Xtardew. Instructions on such in README contained within.
